decision.reason: The artifact identifies the LCP element but does not provide an LCP duration relative to navigation start. Its CDP event time/renderTime/loadTime values are absolute monotonic timestamps, and no navigation-start timestamp is preserved to normalize them. The field lcpDetails.size=143224 is rendered area, not bytes, despite the handoff labeling it as element size in bytes.

missingEvidence.navigationStartOnCdpClock: Missing; absolute PerformanceTimeline timestamps cannot be converted after the fact
missingEvidence.sizeSemanticsCorrection: lcpDetails.size is the rendered area of the LCP entry, not encoded bytes

reviewerReproduction.note: Managed Chromium did not expose LCP entries, matching the R40 limitation. Resource timings and loading policy were independently reconfirmed; they do not substitute for the missing LCP metric.

requiredFollowup: For each run, record navigation start and final LCP entry on the same clock, then persist normalizedLcpMs=(lcpEvent.time-navigationRequestTimestamp)*1000 (or equivalent PerformanceObserver startTime). Keep TTFB and image resource timing. Rename lcpDetails.size to renderedAreaPx2; do not call it bytes.
